scope: Current Xenoverse 2-specific mechanics and acquisition evidence reviewed during Batch 424.
findings: Ki Blast Ultimate obtained from the TP Medal Shop. Current dedicated Xenoverse 2 documentation describes a right-hand beam that can be repeatedly commanded to consume additional Ki and extend the attack; the documented output ranges from 9 hits/30% damage at base to 45 hits/90% damage at maximum output. The attack is long-range and causes knockback.
unresolved: The documented '300+' Ki presentation is retained without inventing a precise upper cost.
Exact charge/input timing and per-stage Ki increments are unresolved.
Damage values are treated as current source-reported values, not timeless patch-independent balance.
